name: Teleman
tagline: A browser calling workspace for agents: dial, take calls, check voicemail, and see the day's numbers in one screen.
description: Teleman is the agent workspace I built for phone teams. An agent signs in, gets a line and an extension, and works from one screen: a dialer, recent calls, voicemail, and personal stats. Call history, outcomes, and voicemail come from the same call data instead of a separate spreadsheet.

coverImage.alt: Teleman agent workspace with a browser dialer, line status, and recent calls

screenshots.alt: Call history filtered by missed, incoming, and outgoing, with outcomes such as completed and callback requested
Voicemail inbox with playback and a short transcript for each message
Agent stats for calls, talk time, answer rate, and inbound versus outbound mix
Call audio settings, ringtone, desktop notifications, and keyboard shortcuts

problem: Calling teams jump between a desk phone, a call log, and a voicemail box. Missed calls and callbacks get lost, and an agent cannot see their own day without asking a supervisor for a report.
approach: Put the whole shift in the browser. The dialer, history, voicemail, and stats read the same call records, and the agent can set themselves away or open a supervisor view without leaving the workspace.
solution: A ConnectPoint-style agent workspace. The agent dials from a keypad or calls back from history, filters calls by missed, incoming, and outgoing, and sees outcomes such as completed, no answer, and callback requested. Voicemail plays in the app with a short transcript. A stats view shows the day's volume, talk time, and inbound versus outbound mix. Settings cover the microphone, speaker, ringtone, desktop alerts, and keyboard shortcuts for answer, hang up, and dialing.
features: Browser dialer with line status, extension, and click-to-call from recent calls
Call history with missed, incoming, and outgoing filters
Outcomes on each call, including completed, missed, no answer, and callback requested
Voicemail inbox with playback and a transcript preview
Agent presence, including set-away, plus a supervisor view
Personal stats for volume, talk time, answer rate, and call mix
Audio devices, ringtone, desktop notifications, and keyboard shortcuts
architecture: A web agent workspace on top of a call backend. Dial, answer, and hang-up actions update live call state, and completed calls write into history, voicemail, and the stats view the agent sees.
